dedupe_keys.name: amazonas multi device and multi operator cellular coverage observations

description: This dataset records mobile-network conditions collected with Android smartphones and tablets along roads and rivers in Amazonas, Brazil. Federal University of Amazonas collaborators provide ten samples from nine cities, grouped into Manaus, the middle Solimões and the middle Amazonas regions. The complete database has 736,974 rows and thirty-three columns, including location, timestamps, received power, signal quality and channel indicators. This is the total collection size, despite an ambiguous repository sentence mentioning daily records. Mendeley version 2 provides CSV data, Python and notebook analysis, an Armadeira collector application and its manual free under CC BY 4.0. Exact collection dates and a uniform sampling interval are not established. Routes, operators and device choices limit interpretation as continuous regional coverage. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating connectivity constraints in transport and communications simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related modelling environment. No dataset, application installer or analysis script was downloaded or run.
